deepdive.thesis: Recode Studios is a fast-growing, asset-light Indian beauty brand leveraging omnichannel distribution (COCO/FOFO stores + 72% direct online sales) and strong digital engagement to drive revenue doubling and EBITDA margin expansion. With IPO proceeds fueling working capital and retail expansion, it is positioned to capture India’s premiumizing BPC market through scalable, high-margin product lines.
